capabilities: display file created/modified dates, size, and image dimensions
open the active file in its native application or its folder
count characters, words, sentences, paragraphs, and lines for the note and selected text
generate a word frequency report with optional regex filtering
estimate page count from a configurable words-per-page setting
extras: Tested on Mac, Windows 11, and mobile on Obsidian v0.12.19; CSS variables are documented for customizing the panel's text. The README also promotes the author's books.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in panel showing detailed metadata of the active file or statistics like sentence, paragraph, page, and word-frequency counts.
summary: Sidebar panel that shows the active file's created/modified dates, size, image dimensions, and links to open the file or folder, plus writing statistics.
